title: Sometimes We 'Spread Ourself Too Thin'
credits: Anna Matteo wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: And now, Words and Their Stories, from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 现在，这里是美国之音英语学习节目《词汇与故事》。

sentences.en: Today we talk about our busy lives.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来聊聊我们忙碌的生活。

sentences.en: Many people have family and work responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 许多人承担着家庭和工作的责任。

sentences.en: We might have religious or community activities.
sentences.zh: 我们可能还有宗教或社区活动。

sentences.en: Taking care of our health is also important.
sentences.zh: 照顾好自己的健康同样重要。

sentences.en: And let’s not forget about our personal projects, our interests, and our friendships.
sentences.zh: 别忘了我们个人的项目、兴趣和友谊。

sentences.en: With everything on our plate, it is easy to feel overwhelmed, overextended, and overcommitted.
sentences.zh: 面对这么多事情，我们很容易感到不堪重负、顾此失彼、负担过重。

sentences.en: However, if we try to do too much, we may spread ourselves too thin.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果我们想做的事情太多，就可能把自己摊得太开。

sentences.en: This expression means we have taken on too much.
sentences.zh: 这个表达的意思是，我们承担得太多了。

sentences.en: We are pushed to the limit.
sentences.zh: 我们被推到了极限。

sentences.en: People who are spread too thin, take on too many jobs, projects, or goals.
sentences.zh: 那些把自己摊得太开的人，承担的工作、项目或目标太多。

sentences.en: The heavy load requires more energy or attention than they possess.
sentences.zh: 这沉重的负担需要比他们所能提供的更多精力或注意力。

sentences.en: If we work on many projects simultaneously, or at the same time, it is possible that none will get done well, if they get done at all.
sentences.zh: 如果我们同时推进许多项目，或者说在同一时间做许多事，那么很可能没有哪一件能做好，甚至可能一件都做不成。

sentences.en: And it is possible such multitasking could stress us out.
sentences.zh: 而且，这种多任务处理可能会让我们压力倍增。

sentences.en: Being spread too thin can also be described as biting off more than we can chew.
sentences.zh: 把自己摊得太开，也可以说是“贪多嚼不烂”。

sentences.en: When we bite off more than we can chew, we attempt to do more than is possible.
sentences.zh: 当我们“贪多嚼不烂”时，我们试图去做超出能力范围的事情。

sentences.en: Now, let’s hear these some of these terms and expressions used in a conversation.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来听一段对话，看看其中一些术语和表达的实际用法。

sentences.en: A: So, how are your classes going?
sentences.zh: A：那么，你的课程进展如何？

sentences.en: B: Not great.
sentences.zh: B：不太好。

sentences.en: Many of my best students are failing my course.
sentences.zh: 我最好的许多学生都在我的课上不及格。

sentences.en: They all missed an important deadline for a project.
sentences.zh: 他们都错过了一个项目的重要截止日期。

sentences.en: A: That's strange.
sentences.zh: A：真奇怪。

sentences.en: What else do they have going on?
sentences.zh: 他们还有什么别的事在忙吗？

sentences.en: B: A lot!
sentences.zh: B：可多了！

sentences.en: They are all performing in the same play.
sentences.zh: 他们都在同一部话剧里演出。

sentences.en: So, they have had rehearsals every night for the past month.
sentences.zh: 所以，过去一个月来他们每天晚上都要排练。

sentences.en: And many have part-time jobs as well.
sentences.zh: 而且许多人还有兼职工作。

sentences.en: A: Sounds like they’ve spread themselves too thin.
sentences.zh: A：听起来他们把战线拉得太长了。

sentences.en: They’ve got too much going on.
sentences.zh: 他们手头的事实在太多了。

sentences.en: B: I think you’re right.
sentences.zh: B：我觉得你说得对。

sentences.en: A: So, what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: A：那么，你打算怎么做呢？

sentences.en: B: Well, first I’ll extend the deadline.
sentences.zh: B：嗯，首先我会延长截止日期。

sentences.en: And then I’m going to warn them about biting off more than they can chew.
sentences.zh: 然后我会提醒他们别贪多嚼不烂。

sentences.en: And that’s all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期“Words and Their Stories”的全部内容。

sentences.en: Until next time, I’m Anna Matteo.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见，我是Anna Matteo。
